paper_title: The Evolution of Darija Open Dataset Introducing Version 2
caption: Distribution of Content Types in the DODa
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of content types within the DODa dataset. The chart contains six slices, representing Moroccan Names, Semantic Categories, Syntactic Roles, Translated Sentences, Extra + Augmented Data, and Pending Translations. The slices are colored red, purple, gold, light blue, steel blue, and light green, respectively. Numerical values are displayed alongside four of the slices: 23,108 for Moroccan Names, 45,387 for Translated Sentences, 30,000 for Extra + Augmented Data, and 43,000 for Pending Translations. A legend is included to identify each category by color and name. The segments appear to be arranged in descending order by size, moving clockwise from Pending Translations to Moroccan Names. The chart features a three-dimensional appearance with an offset effect, giving the impression that some slices are slightly detached from the center.
